featured_title: RiverCreek Estero FL: What Is a Resale Worth When the Builder Is Discounting? 2026
featured_excerpt: In RiverCreek, every resale competes with GL Homes' own final-closeout homes, so value a resale against what the builder's comparable home costs after incentives, then adjust for what each one includes. RiverCreek has no CDD on Lee County's list, recent listings show an HOA fee of about $386 to $395 a month, and the addresses we checked are in FEMA Zone X.
